intended_writes: Only disposable /private/tmp/explorer-http-* fixture tree, its exact owned private runtime files and service/read worker. The ordinary OS default browser opens one new tab using its existing settings.
credential_boundary: Actual command handler calls explore --open and passes private URL to stdlib webbrowser in process memory. It emits no bootstrap URL/token. Do not inventory or inspect the new browser tab before browser_ready has confirmed the context request; if no ready event, report unavailable inspection and let the 300-second lifetime close the service.
inspection: Wait for browser_ready, select only the actual OS-created tab at the expected clean URL, and positively verify absence of bootstrap before any URL/text/screenshot output. Do not navigate a replacement tab.

Observe and record actual native browser zoom value. Set actual browser zoom to 200 percent and verify the native UI value; no CSS font-size, pageScaleFactor or viewport-only substitute. Do not change browser defaults or accessibility settings.

At200percent inspect labeled Search, navigation and session controls. Open the Starting points Alignment entry, Sources, and first recorded source; inspect source text, source heading/return controls and horizontal reflow. Close source, open Processes, then first recorded process; inspect ordered text/process reading controls and reflow. Only synthetic fixture content is displayed.
Restore and positively verify the exact prior browser zoom value before closing only the created tab. Restore prior focus when practical. Record any unsupported observations explicitly.
Stop exact owned driver with normal SIGTERM after inspection, wait for browser_cleanup/exit0, and verify created test tab absence. The driver also has a bounded300-second lifetime.
cleanup: SIGTERM to exact started driver PID or its 300-second bounded lifetime sets production service stopping; normal command closes socket/private files/worker. Driver compares fixture regular bytes and reaps worker, then removes only its disposable fixture. Host verifies owned driver exit and closes the exact created browser tab.
attribution: Actual OS default-browser dispatch through in-process verified production command(... explore --open), with native browser inspection separate. Literal public CLI startup is independently covered by service batch05; this job must not be relabeled a public CLI subprocess invocation.
scope: Current full production frontend on unchanged SERVICE package; actual native200percent browser zoom and exact prior-setting restoration. No VoiceOver/human comprehension/performance/release acceptance.
